sources.snippet: PiD-Image-Upscaler is an experimental, advanced super-resolution and image-to-image refinement application based on the state-of-the-art PiD (Pixel Diffusion Decoder) framework by NVIDIA. This application couples local generative text-to-image and image-to-image pipelines with a structural 4-step student diffusion sampler to deliver clean, crisp 4 × $4\times$ image upscaling.
